content.short: Not Pixel is a multiplayer Telegram and TON game where users collaborate and compete through pixel-based play.
content.description: Not Pixel is described as a multiplayer gaming platform based on Telegram and the TON blockchain. The project fits the TON games category because it uses Telegram distribution, shared game activity, and token or reward mechanics around a social pixel-art style experience. It is a game listing, not a wallet or exchange. Not Pixel is a multiplayer gaming platform based on Telegram and TON blockchain. Not Pixel is a game listing because users interact through play, progression, competition, collectibles, rewards, or community challenges.
